product.name: Lians Make
product.summary: Describe what your group needs. Get a working app you can use and share.

workflow.label: Describe
workflow.detail: Write one sentence about the group result you need.

workflow.label: Make
workflow.detail: Lians selects a safe app shape and publishes a working result.

workflow.label: Use
workflow.detail: People join from one link without creating accounts.

workflow.label: Spread
workflow.detail: Every app can be shared and remixed into the next app.

surfaces.label: Make page
surfaces.detail: One prompt creates a challenge, vote, quiz, leaderboard, tracker, or shared list.

surfaces.label: Shared app
surfaces.detail: Each result has persistent shared state, a participant name, sharing, and remixing.

surfaces.label: Growth events
surfaces.detail: Creation, views, participation, shares, and remixes can be measured from first-party data.

product.activation: A created app receives a meaningful action from a second person.
